assignment: By experiment, establish the two F1 design facts: (a) exit code + JSON envelope of `claude -p --output-format json` when auth fails / is_error is true; (b) which credential is named when BOTH ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are set (both bogus, distinguishable). Report the macOS keychain/OAuth confound explicitly.
wrapper_confound: `which claude` on this Mac resolves to /Applications/cmux.app/Contents/Resources/bin/claude, a bash wrapper that injects hooks; its SessionEnd hook appends a NON-JSON line AFTER the result object, so `json.load(whole file)` raises 'Extra data'. Every rerun below invokes the real binary directly.
verdict: Exit code is TRUSTWORTHY (0 on success, 1 on every observed failure). `subtype` is a LIAR — it stays "success" on 401 auth failure, 404 bad model, and not-logged-in. The honest discriminators are is_error (bool), terminal_reason (completed|api_error), api_error_status (int|null) and result (human string). ANTHROPIC_API_KEY WINS over CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN when both are set. Two non-exit-code hazards for F1: (1) an auth-failed turn still emits total_cost_usd:0, which record_spend records as a real $0.00 claude-cli-json row — a failed turn is indistinguishable from a cheap one unless is_error is read; (2) an unreachable ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL HANGS with ZERO output past 100s, and fleet-run.sh has no timeout and no set -e.

recipes.claim: auth failure: exit=1, is_error=true, subtype="success" (lie), api_error_status=401, terminal_reason="api_error", result="Invalid API key · Fix external API key", total_cost_usd=0
recipes.rerun: cd /tmp && env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$(mktemp -d) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-bogus-verify /Users/frikkjarl/.local/bin/claude -p 'Reply OK' --model haiku --output-format json > c_err3.json 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; cat c_err3.json

recipes.claim: both creds set -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is the one named
recipes.rerun: cd /tmp && env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$(mktemp -d) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-bogusA CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=bogusB /Users/frikkjarl/.local/bin/claude -p 'hi' --model haiku --output-format json 2>&1 | tail -c 300
recipes.expect: api_error_status:401 with result "Invalid API key · Fix external API key" (NOT the bearer-token message)

recipes.rerun: cd /tmp && env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$(mktemp -d) CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=bogusB /Users/frikkjarl/.local/bin/claude -p 'hi' --model haiku --output-format json 2>&1 | tail -c 300
recipes.expect: result "Failed to authenticate. API Error: 401 Invalid bearer token"

recipes.rerun: cd /tmp && env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$(mktemp -d) /Users/frikkjarl/.local/bin/claude -p 'hi' --model haiku --output-format json 2>&1 | tail -c 300
recipes.expect: exit=1, api_error_status:null, result "Not logged in · Please run /login"

recipes.claim: macOS keychain confound: with the REAL HOME, bogus env credentials are silently IGNORED and the turn succeeds against the stored OAuth login (and BILLS the real account)
recipes.rerun: cd /tmp && ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-bogus-verify CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=bogusB /Users/frikkjarl/.local/bin/claude -p 'hi' --model haiku --output-format json 2>&1 | tail -c 300
recipes.expect: exit=0, is_error:false, real total_cost_usd > 0 -- proving the env vars were not consulted

recipes.claim: unreachable ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL hangs >100s with a 0-byte log
recipes.rerun: cd /tmp && ( env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$(mktemp -d) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-bogus ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 /Users/frikkjarl/.local/bin/claude -p 'hi' --model haiku --output-format json > c_url3.json 2>&1 & P=$!; for i in $(seq 1 100); do kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null || break; /bin/sleep 1; done; kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null && { echo 'STILL RUNNING after 100s'; kill -9 $P; } ); wc -c c_url3.json
